definitions.explanation: A general term for a store or shop. More commonly used in compounds or older speech.
A person who runs a shop. This usage is somewhat dated.

examples.english: A new shop opened in front of the station.

notes:
{店屋|みせや} is a somewhat older word for shop or store.

COMMON COMPOUND:
- {店屋|てんや}{物|もの}: takeout food; delivery food (from restaurants)
  Note: In this compound, the reading changes to てんや

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: shop, store (common)
- ⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧: store, business premises (formal)
- ⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧: shop (loanword)

{店屋|てんや}{物|もの} is still commonly used to refer to restaurant takeout or delivery food, especially when contrasting with home-cooked meals.
